summary: rename the claim module to ownership
pull_request_body: Rename the claim module to `ownership` so that its name states the data it holds. The move keeps every public name of the module, and it changes the import lines of its callers.
why: The name `claim` says one operation of the module and hides the owner fields that it holds. The rename gives the module the name of the data that it owns.
what_changes: Rename `src/devops_cli/roadmap/claim.py` to `src/devops_cli/roadmap/ownership.py` and keep its public names.
Change the import lines of the callers of the module in `src/` and `tests/`.
feasibility: The staged tree holds `src/devops_cli/roadmap/claim.py`, and the plan lists it in `changes` and creates the new path.
The two test modules import the old dotted name of the module, so the move must change them as well.
existing_tool: The `git mv` of the implement step and the `references` tool of the stage planner cover the need, so the plan builds no tool.

groups.title: Rename the claim module to ownership
groups.implementation: Move the module to its new path and keep every public name that it exports.
